correctness.rationale: Every one of 65,536 subsets passes two independently specified face predicates. The complete 32,390-nonempty-face Hasse graph with 218,672 coverings has an explicitly printed matching of 16,191 pairs, one critical vertex and seven critical 7-simplices; a full topological sort certifies acyclicity. Forman discrete Morse gives an integral wedge of seven 7-spheres because no intermediate cells exist. Separately reduced mod-two boundary ranks corroborate. Exhaustive enumeration of all 96 adjacency-preserving graph automorphisms, complete conjugation classes, orientation signs on every stabilized face and Hopf trace formula give all 13 character values, with weighted sum 0 and squared sum 384.

value.rationale: A natural incidence graph with sixteen vertices has a dominance complex whose exact integral homotopy was not provided by the inspected forest/chordal theorems. Its full 96-element top homology symmetry action is an additional canonical invariant inaccessible from the Betti number or nonequivariant wedge alone; distinct automorphisms with identical 16-vertex permutation cycle structure have different homology traces. A single fully self-contained finite classification with complete group representation is a motivated exact mathematical target, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
